about: How long a device may wait before a try to reconnect (spec/sync-protocol.md, Reconnecting): tries counts the tries since the last Welcome, this one included; the most is firstMs doubled for each try before it, up to mostMs (socketRules.reconnectFirstMs and reconnectMostMs in design/src/socket.ts), and the device waits a time drawn at random from 0 up to that most.

waitMost.name: and no further, however many tries
